EQUITY AND HUMAN RELATIONS COMMISSION AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 7, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:00 PM

Dr. Eduardo Lara, Chair  Sanghak Kan, Commissioner
Christopher Covington, Vice Chair  Cheryl Koll, Commissioner
Dr. Sharifa Batts, Commissioner  M. Lissette Flores, Commissioner
Robbie Butler, Commissioner  Keyona Montgomery, Commissioner
Jessica Gillette, Commissioner  Jon Schultz, Commissioner
Alyssa Gutierrez, Commissioner

  EQUITY AND HUMAN RELATIONS COMMISSION IN-PERSON MEETING

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TONY.VIRAMONTES@LONGBEACH.GOV

  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 934 3163 3115
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/93431633115

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

CHAIR REMARKS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-52097  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Equity and Human Relations
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, January 10, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-52100  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-52101  Recommendation to discuss and approve recommendations to the Mayor and the
  City Council intended to reduce recidivism of previously incarcerated community
  members, such as, advancing employment, workforce development, re-entry
  programming and similar opportunities.

  Page 1 of 2

  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 7, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CARMELITOS CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 6:00 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-52102  Recommendation to receive and file a report from the Office of Equity regarding the
  FY24 Budget as related to the Equity and Human Relations Commission.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-52103  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Equity and Human
  Relations Commission Chair and Vice Chair on expectations of Commissioner
  attendance and vacancies, and if appropriate, draft recommendations regarding
  vacancies of the Equity and Human Relations Commission to the Mayor and City
  Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-52104  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Office of Equity.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Equity and Human Relations Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
cityclerk@longbeach.gov.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Schultz, seconded by Commissioner
  Gillette, to approve recommendation. No vote was taken on the motion.

A motion was made by Chair Lara, seconded by Commissioner Schultz, to
approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] receive and file a report
from the Office of Equity regarding the FY24 Budget as related to the Equity
and Human Relations Commission; and [2] distribute the $12,500 budget
allocated for the Equity and Human Relations Commission as follows: $5,000
for Branding, $5,000 for Community Engagement and $2,500 for Capacity
Building and Training. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  10 Batts, Butler, Gillette, Kan, Koll, Lissette Flores, Montgomery,
  Schultz, Covington, Lara

5.  24-52103  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Equity and Human

  attendance and vacancies, and if appropriate, draft recommendations regarding
  vacancies of the Equity and Human Relations Commission to the Mayor and City

  A motion was made by Vice Chair Covington, seconded by Commissioner
  Batts, to approve recommendation, as amended, [1] to receive and file a
  presentation from the Equity and Human Relations Commission Chair and
  Vice Chair on expectations of Commissioner attendance and vacancies; and
